title: Lester Young's sound
summary: Roy says Lester sounded when they first met as he did later.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
story.community_name: Remembering Lester Young: Prez the man and his sound

blocks.x: When you first met Lester, was he playing the same way?
Well, I think... You say the same way. All I know, he was a good player. I liked the way he played. I couldn't say the same way or...
Well, we don't know anything about what he sounded like until he made his first records, which were amazing.
He sounded the same. He didn't play like Coleman or nothing; he had his own thing. That I know. Did you go to that Jo Jones thing the other night?
